_comment: Outer Claude Code timeouts are generous ceilings. TokenSmith enforces a MUCH tighter internal budget (see config.performance.*) and always returns a structured no-op response before the outer timeout fires, so the hook never blocks the session.

SessionStart.description: Open the TokenSmith DB for this project (internal budget: 150ms)

PostToolUse.description: Optionally auto-save meaningful tool outputs (internal budget: 100ms)

SessionEnd.description: Summarise session and close DB (internal budget: 1s)
